claims: Finding 1: `reviewed` state may be unreachable — `scripts/pr/pr-ready-state-core.mjs:759-770` gives `reviewed` exactly one route: a CodeRabbit review record whose body matches `**Run ID**` and whose commit oid equals the head, both resting on unverified assumptions

1(a): the clean-run completion text (`"No actionable comments were generated in the recent review. 🎉"`) appears in the top-level walkthrough issue comment which carries no Run ID, so the `**Run ID**` body match won't fire for clean runs (`pr-feedback-state.test.mjs:3355-3373`)
1(a): the new issue-comment loop at `pr-ready-state-core.mjs:772-784` only matches the agent's own request marker; it never inspects CodeRabbit-authored comments

1(b): `isCurrentReviewSignal` (`:657-658`) takes the oid branch whenever `currentHeadOid` is set, and it always is (`:875`); if gh's `reviews` field carries no commit, `reviewCommitOid` returns null and `reviewed` is unreachable whatever the body says

Consequence of finding 1: every PR reads `stale`/`missing`, and the closeout rule posts `@coderabbitai review` on PRs CodeRabbit already reviewed cleanly — spending the Pro+ ladder round the ADR change exists to save

Finding 2: the request marker is accepted from any author — `scripts/pr/pr-ready-state-core.mjs:772-784` has no author or association check, unlike `parseReadinessOverrideComment` (`:523-556`) and `issue-board-backfill.mjs:90`; anyone who copies the public head SHA into the marker flips the state to `requested`, and the runbook then forbids the authorized request for that head, silently skipping an advisory review

Finding 3: watchlist drift — `scripts/pr/pr-ready-state-core.mjs` goes 889 → 961 rough lines (998 → 1,077 raw) while `docs/notes/file-size-watch.md:53` still records `888 | 993 | soft cap`, and policy at `docs/pr-checklists/recurring-review-patterns.md:191-194` says don't append to a file already drifting up

Finding 4: documented JSON sample now incomplete — `docs/notes/pr-ready-state.md:275-296` still shows four gates while the same file's new prose (`:111-127`, `:351-356`) says the projection exposes `codeRabbitReviewSignal`
`scripts/coderabbit-config.test.mjs` could not run because `js-yaml` is not installed, so the config pin is unverified coverage
The two passing suites run over hand-written fixtures that encode the very assumptions finding 1 questions, so green is not evidence the classifier works against real CodeRabbit output

judge_reasoning.3829654081: Finding 3 reports the same growth (889→961 rough, 998→1,077 raw) in pr-ready-state-core.mjs and cites the recurring-review policy against appending to an already-oversized file.
judge_reasoning.3829659544: Finding 4 flags that the documented gates JSON sample in docs/notes/pr-ready-state.md still shows four gates and omits codeRabbitReviewSignal.
judge_reasoning.3829659546: The review never discusses the ordering of the CodeRabbit closeout rule relative to the feedback-state/ready-state projection pair across the workflow and ship mirrors.
judge_reasoning.3829659550: Finding 1(b) argues the opposite (currentHeadOid is always set so the oid branch always wins); nothing in the review flags the null-currentHeadOid fallback to review timestamps or acceptance of any marked request as unsafe.

1.why: Both stated legs fail: `gh pr view --json reviews` does emit `commit{oid}` (confirmed in the gh 2.96 GraphQL fragment: `reviews(first:100){nodes{author,authorAssociation,submittedAt,body,state,commit{oid},...}}`), and CodeRabbit run bodies carry `**Run ID**`; `reviewed` is reachable via pr-ready-state-core.mjs:759-770 as the new tests at pr-ready-state.test.mjs:2223-2270 exercise.

2.why: pr-feedback-state.test.mjs:3359-3372 only shows the walkthrough issue comment carrying the 🎉 line; it does not show that a clean run posts no review record — the real review body shape recorded at pr-ready-state.test.mjs:2226-2229 pairs `Actionable comments posted: N` with `**Run ID**`, and the classifier reads reviews, not the walkthrough.

3.why: The loop at :772-784 does only match the closeout marker, which is its stated purpose (docs/notes/pr-ready-state.md:113-127); the claim names no failing case of its own once the reviews-array route is shown to work.

4.why: Premise disproved: gh's `reviews` field includes `commit{oid}` (verified in the gh binary's GraphQL query), so `reviewCommitOid` (:647-655) returns the oid and the :658 branch resolves; `currentHeadOid` at :875 is also `?? null`, not unconditionally set.

5.why: Follows only from claim 1, which is false — `reviewed` fires for a Run-ID review whose `commit.oid` equals `pr.headRefOid`, so PRs do not uniformly read stale/missing.

6.why: No author/association check on the marker at :772-784 — this is the already-known 'Trust only authorized closeout requests' / 'Authenticate closeout markers in the cloud loop' pair.

7.why: pr-ready-state-core.mjs grew 998→1077 raw lines while docs/notes/file-size-watch.md:53 still says 888|993, but the substance is the already-known 'Split the growing ready-state core' finding.

8.why: docs/notes/pr-ready-state.md:222 labels the block 'Expected top-level fields', yet its `gates` sample (:275-296) and top-level fields (:305) still omit `codeRabbitReviewSignal` that the same file documents at :111-127 and :351-356 and that the code emits at pr-ready-state-core.mjs:1008/1068; distinct from the known :369/:408 anchors.

9.why: js-yaml is a declared dependency (package.json:155, `js-yaml: 4.3.1`); the checkout simply has no node_modules at all, so this is a reviewer-environment artifact, not a defect in the change.

10.why: Generic meta-commentary about fixture-based tests; names no concrete incorrect fixture or missing case beyond the already-refuted finding 1.
